assistant|restaurant_recommendation: Pizzarium - rated one of the best pizza places in Rome
La Locanda dei Girasoli - authentic Italian dishes, cozy atmosphere
Roscioli - famous deli with cured meats, cheeses, traditional Roman cuisine
Caffè Vaticano - historic coffee shop with view of St. Peter's Basilica
assistant|shopping_advice: Souvenir shops around Vatican sell religious items, postcards, books, art prints; prices may be higher near Vatican
assistant|gelato_recommendation: Gelateria del Teatro - creative flavors like white peach and lavender, dark chocolate and orange
Giolitti - historic gelato shop over 100 years old, known for fig, coconut, hazelnut flavors
Fatamorgana - small chain with gluten-free and vegan options, flavors like cinnamon, honey, rosemary
San Crispino - historic shop since 1947, classic flavors like tiramisu and pistachio
La Romana - popular chain with fresh ingredients, seasonal flavors like fig and ricotta
